name: Lethal Wounds raises Serrated Shot's tick-rate modifier by 20% (#2498)
contract: 705055 'Lethal Wounds' reads 'Increases the tick rate of your periodic damage effects by 20%.' It is a single SPELL_AURA_ADD_PCT_MODIFIER, MiscValue 19 = SPELLMOD_ACTIVATION_TIME, BasePoints -21+1=-20, class mask (134316032, 3321889792, 2147484896) = word0 bits {15,16,27}, word1 bits {10,25,26,30,31}, word2 bits {5,6,7,10,31}. Serrated Shot rank 1 (500073, SPELL_AURA_PERIODIC_DAMAGE) has SpellFamilyFlags (0,0,128) = word2 bit 7, one of the bits in Lethal Wounds' mask: a direct, confirmed match, not a guess. AuraEffect::CalculatePeriodic (src/server/game/Spells/Auras/SpellAuraEffects.cpp) unconditionally applies modOwner->ApplySpellMod(id, SPELLMOD_ACTIVATION_TIME, amplitude) for every periodic aura, so no script is needed: a -20% activation-time modifier turns a tick interval into 80% of its base. Before this passive the query returns the unmodified base; after learning it the same query must return 0.8x.

steps.label: CONTRACT: Serrated Shot's tick-interval modifier drops to 80%
